source_contexts.source: Your song title and instrument filter are sent to TelemetryDeck. Do not include personal information.
source_contexts.context: Privacy disclosure in Request a song alert before an explicit Send. Song-title text and current instrument filter are sent to named TelemetryDeck service. Instruct not to enter personal information. No audio recording/transmission, anonymity guarantee, consent status or additional data category may be invented.

source_contexts.source: Song requests are unavailable in this build.
source_contexts.context: Unavailable because this app build has no configured telemetry app ID. Scope is this build, not a claim that all song requests or the entire app are globally unavailable. A Support alternative exists.

source_contexts.source: Song requests are unavailable while usage sharing is off.
source_contexts.context: Unavailable while saved usage-data-sharing preference is off. State the condition without directing or pressuring the user to enable it; Support remains an alternative. No claim requests are sent despite opt-out.

source_contexts.source: Your request could not be sent. Try again later.
source_contexts.context: A request send failed (network/server/revocation or unavailable at send-time). Input is retained in code. Say send did not succeed and invite retry later; do not claim acknowledgement, delivery or automatic retry.
Footer status while the asynchronous send is pending. No completed-success or failure claim. Preserve the single ellipsis character.
